privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sections: Summary
CLN Lacrosse does not require an account and does not collect personal information. Your favorite and watched teams and your settings are stored only on your device. We do not sell data.
Information stored on your device

Favorite team, watched teams and app settings (such as alert preferences) are saved in the App’s local storage on your phone. They are not sent to our servers. Resetting the App from Help, or deleting the App, removes them.
Information we receive automatically

When the App loads scores, stats or news it requests data from our servers (hosted on Railway) and from content delivery networks for logos and images. Like any web server, these receive your IP address, device/app version and the pages requested, and keep standard server logs for a limited time for security and troubleshooting. We do not use these logs to identify or profile you.
Notifications

If you turn on push notifications in a store-installed version of the App, Apple or Google will issue a device token so we can deliver alerts you asked for (goals, final scores, game reminders). The token is tied to your device, not to you, and is deleted when you turn notifications off or uninstall.
Analytics and advertising
The App currently contains no analytics SDKs, advertising networks or third-party trackers. If that changes, we will update this policy and describe any choices you have.
Third-party sites
Links to school athletics sites, broadcasters, streaming services and collegelacrossenews.com open in your browser or an in-app browser and are governed by those sites’ own privacy policies.
Children
The Service is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.
Your choices and rights

Because we hold no personal data about App users, there is nothing to access, correct or delete on our side; use Reset in Help to clear on-device data. If you contact us by e-mail we keep that correspondence to respond to you. Residents of California, the EU/UK and other regions may contact us to exercise any applicable rights.
Changes
We may update this policy as the App gains features. The “Last updated” date above will change, and material changes will be noted in the App.
Contact
Call Partner Group LLC d/b/a College Lacrosse News — use the E-mail Support link in the App or the contact page at collegelacrossenews.com.
